applied_constraints: Host-initiated vsock acknowledges the assigned host port, not the requested guest port.
Reserved guest control port and host CID2 are independently required; no TCP transport fallback.
Jailer creates/copies/chowns an executable and creates a new PID namespace; launcher PID is not VMM PID.
PID-file creation precedes the child exec and credential drop. Authenticate executable, UID, parent, generation, cgroup and namespace before retaining pidfd signaling authority.
Use preconfigured owned cgroup v2 leaf with no cgroup property flags; do not change unrelated ancestor controller settings.
Tokio deprecated AsyncFd::new; use unsafe register with a privately owned stable fd and explicit safety invariant.

libc0.2.191 ioctl request uses c_ulong on GNU but c_int on musl; the fixed low loopback request numbers are converted to the target function argument type. Native GNU pass alone cannot establish the static musl build.
hardware_acceptance: separate actual jailed guest gate required
